text:
noah: FYI deploy-bot aborted the staging push for search-indexer:pr-9001. got a layer checksum mismatch on finalize (layer 2/4).

deploy-bot: publish aborted: layer_checksum_mismatch. details:
  tag=staging-pr-9001
  uploaded layers=2/4
  expected_layer_sha256=74f2... got=74f9...
  finalize_digest_mismatch=true
  action=abort

ci-bot: pipeline artifacts for PR-9001 are in cache as ci-art-9001 -> computed manifest sha256:bb22...; cosign signed during pipeline but sign step shows digest bb22..., deploy finalization shows different manifest.

ops: quick scan of proxy logs shows mirror-proxy-4 returned intermittent 502s at 2026-01-12T16:41:12Z and 16:41:14Z; builder retried chunk uploads. opening INF-2105 to investigate proxy packet reassembly/corruption.

beth: recommendation: pin staging slot to last-known-good digest sha256:88aa..., hold the canary, republish the cached artifact (no rebuild) to a new explicit tag, then re-sign/attach provenance and verify across mirrors before promoting.

deploy-bot: previous_staging_digest search-indexer -> sha256:88aa... (2026-01-11T02:03:05Z)

release-manager: approve hold and remove this image from today's EU change window. add to release notes: "search-indexer staging publish held due to layer checksum mismatch; republish + reattest in progress."

ci-bot: republish started: ci-art-9001 -> staging-repub-9001 (preserve-manifest). watch: https://publishbot.internal/ops/9001

ops: INF-2105 created and linked. will add auto-rotate for mirror-proxy-4 if 5xx > 3/min and alert on finalize digest variance.

ci-bot: cosign verify passed for staging-repub-9001 @sha256:88aa...; attestation uploaded. provenance-checker verify -> OK.

deploy-bot: republish complete. staging tag staging-repub-9001 pinned to sha256:88aa...; publish status=success; attestation=present.

beth: kicking a short staging canary now against the republished tag. will monitor pulls/errors for 15m.

noah: if canary is green, schedule manual promote outside EU change window tomorrow morning.

release-manager: canary green after 16m. manual promote scheduled for 2026-01-13 06:00 UTC. release notes updated. will follow up with INF-2105 postmortem link when available. :thumbsup:
